instruction: Enable the background cone display in VLC interface settings

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling VLC background cone display via Tools > Preferences > Interface > Show background cone. Uses existing check_qt_bgcone metric to verify the qt-bgcone setting in vlcrc config file.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary: 1.0 if qt-bgcone is set to 1 in VLC config, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_vlc_config) correctly extracts the VLC configuration file (vlcrc) where qt-bgcone setting is stored
Metric (check_qt_bgcone) correctly reads and compares the qt-bgcone setting value from the config file
Expected value 'qt-bgcone=1' semantically matches the instruction requirement to enable background cone display
Complete coverage: evaluator directly verifies the specific setting required by the instruction
Config file is persistent storage, not dependent on UI state - verification works even after settings dialog closes
Robust edge case handling: defaults to '1' (VLC's documented default), handles file not found and type conversions
Static validation warning about UI dependency is a false positive - this task reads persistent config, not transient UI state
